gaps.note: The reader has no calculus or analysis in the profile. Limits, convergence of an infinite series and absolute convergence are not explained or linked, so the step from the telescoping identity to the sum equal to N^{-1} cannot be checked.

The stated hypothesis is 2 <= alpha < p, which gives alpha^2 < p^2, not alpha^2 < p. The reader cannot derive alpha^2 < p from the page, so alpha^2 theta > 1 and the bound below 1/2 are not established.
